recorded_from: live-free offline read of the installed 0.7.2 Server/HytaleServer.jar and Assets.zip
status: observed; semantic baseline verified for 1 of 11 audits (inventory, with a recorded caveat); the other 10 fail closed, each with the open gaps named in its entry
notes: Body-change counts are javap bodies with column whitespace collapsed, keyed by method signature (tools/source_pins/rebaseline.py changed). The phase-5 counts of 2026-10-18 were not whitespace-normalised: PositionCache showed 40 changed of 53 common methods, and 17 of 54 after normalisation (the 54 include <clinit>).

Verified means the audit's source claims were read against the 0.7.2 bytecode or bridge code, not that the script's hash was recorded. verified_claims and caveats name the evidence; confirmed_on_072 lists what was read on a fail-closed audit.

Several phase-5 'removed' entries were signature changes: ExplosionUtils.performExplosion (Rotation3f added), WorldUtil.getPackedMaterialAndFluidAtPosition and findFluidBlock (ChunkStore parameter). BlockHarvestUtils.performBlockDamage has three overloads on 0.7.2 and Rotation.add keeps its instance overload.

Gate hazard, not a 0.7.2 finding: the crafting audit reads APPDATA in its argparse default, and the gate sets neither APPDATA nor HYTALE_ASSETS_ZIP, so on macOS the crafting audit raises under the gate once the earlier audits pass (the observe tool sets a placeholder APPDATA).

open_gaps: Unloaded-chunk LOS (claim unloaded_chunk: blocked): LocalCachedChunkAccessor is absent on 0.7.2 with no moved copy. The rule now runs through PositionCache$LineOfSightBuffer.resolveSection (inner class, not pinned). A loaded column with no BlockSection takes the null-section branch of lambda$hasLineOfSightInternal$1, which is not re-derived.

Entity-body LOS (entity_body_blocks_los: false) rests on PositionCache.testLineOfSightEntity, changed on 0.7.2 and not re-derived. hasLineOfSight reads a cached roleIndex field where 0.5.7 called role.getRoleIndex().

Channel and light contracts (getHeight, getTint, sky and block light readiness, ChunkLightingManager, FloodLightCalculation, ChunkStore initialisation) sit on pinned classes that changed: 2 of 26 byte-identical to the 0.5.7 pin, 1 absent, 103 changed bodies in 806 common methods. Not re-derived.
The projected-distance declarations have no recorded 0.7.2 value, so the audit's matches_0_5_7_baseline is false even with a semantic hash recorded. The verifier does not read that flag.
confirmed_on_072: Unloaded start column returns false (blocked) in PositionCache lambda$hasLineOfSightInternal$0: resolveSection returns false, then the lambda returns false (0.5.7: getChunkIfInMemory == null returns false).

open_gaps: Submersion: WorldUtil.getPackedMaterialAndFluidAtPosition, findFarthestEmptySpaceAbove/Below and findFluidBlock are re-signatured to take ChunkStore directly (0.5.7: Ref plus ComponentAccessor). LivingEntity.getPackedMaterialAndFluidAtBreathingHeight changed (1 body). The fill-height and breathing reads are not re-derived.
Fall state: MotionControllerWalk.computeNewFallSpeed, computeMove, executeMove and findDropBlockCollision changed on 0.7.2; the fall-accumulation and landing claims are not re-derived.
Collision: CollisionConfig.canCollide (3 bodies), CollisionModule.processCollision and validatePosition changed. 37 changed bodies in 17 pinned classes (4 byte-identical to the 0.5.7 pin).

MovementStates gains extraJumpsUsed (byte) after the 23 booleans, and its codec moved to MemorySegment/ReadCursor (toObject, requireBounds). The extra-jump state has no constant in the audited set; not re-derived.
MovementConfig gains MaxSlopeAngleDegrees 30 and MaxWallAngleDegrees 15 (MovementConfig.toPacket changed). The previous lane found no reader in the 0.7.2 server (FIDELITY (l)); not re-derived here.

Pinned assets: 6 of 7 differ from the 0.5.7 pins. MovementConfig/Default.json gains the two keys; the transcribed values are unchanged per FIDELITY (b), not re-read by this lane. Test_Dive_Stationary.json is added (dive roles 5 -> 6), a non-hash expectation with no recorded 0.7.2 value.
MotionControllerWalk and ClientFeature changed: 203 changed bodies in 22 pinned classes (8 byte-identical to the 0.5.7 pin).

AStarBase.computePath changed and now returns AStarBase$Progress. The 200 / 200 / 900 limits are instance fields (maxPathLength, openNodesLimit, totalNodesLimit) set outside computePath; the limits, lookup order and open-list order are not re-derived.

Component_Instruction_Intelligent_Chase gains DesiredAltitudeWeight (default -1), read by MotionControllerWalk and BodyMotionFindBase. Its effect on the Trork chase is neither measured nor re-derived.

The four trace assets moved (Faction/ and Instructions/Combat/ paths); the trace pins are recorded at the 0.7.2 paths by the previous lane. Template_Trork_Melee.json gains MemoriesKillRange and MemoriesUnlockedBy. 49 changed bodies in 18 pinned classes (6 byte-identical).

DoorInteraction lost canOpenDoor, isHorizontalDoor, isInFrontOfDoor and DoorInteraction$DoorState. checkDoor now returns DoorBlockUtils$DoorState (DoorBlockUtils is new on 0.7.2 and unpinned), and checkForDoubleDoor takes DoorBlockUtils$DoorState parameters (same shape). The vertical-transition and double-door claims depend on these and are not re-derived.

BlockAccessor.class is absent on 0.7.2. Rotation.add(Rotation, Rotation) is removed (the instance add(Rotation) and toInverse remain; toInverse changed). FillerBlockUtil has 3 changed bodies and 21 added methods. 1 of 6 pinned classes is byte-identical to the 0.5.7 pin.
confirmed_on_072: All 9 pinned door assets in Assets.zip are byte-identical to the 0.5.7 pins (counted from the installed archive).

open_gaps: BlockHealthModule$BlockHealthSystem is absent. The block-health work moved to BlockHealthSystems (Tick, ReplicateChanges, PlaceBlockEventSystem, EnsureSection, LoadPacket, MigrateBlockHealthChunk) and a new BlockHealthSection. The tick-procedure claim is not re-derived.
WorldChunk.setBlock is removed (0 overloads on 0.7.2): a claimed placement path.
342 changed bodies in 78 pinned classes (19 byte-identical to the 0.5.7 pin, 1 absent). The asset census and tick-procedure pins are not recorded for 0.7.2.
ExplosionUtils.performExplosion is re-signatured (Rotation3f added), not removed. Its phase order is confirmed for explosion_dynamics; the mutation claims that run through it are not re-derived.
BlockHarvestUtils.performBlockDamage is present with 3 overloads (2 on 0.5.7); the overload used by the claimed explosion path is not re-derived.

BlockHealthChunk lost damageBlock, getBlockHealth, repairBlock, makeBlockFragile, removeBlock, isBlockFragile and createBlockDamagePackets by name (the block-health API moved). DEBUG_SHAPES is replaced by a debugShapes() method that reads SelectInteraction.SHOW_VISUAL_DEBUG. 165 changed bodies in 12 pinned classes (0 byte-identical).

The host contract (hytalegym/hytalegym/worldgen/native_explosion_dynamics.py and native_explosion_ordering.py) carries the 0.5.7 ExplosionUtils digest as source_class_sha256 and the 0.5.7 DamageSystems digest. The installed classes differ, so the payload names a stale identity. The script cannot express a 0.7.2 identity without re-keying that contract, which this lane does not do.

processTargetEntity changed beyond the audited claims: the damage cause comes from config entityDamageCauseId (a null cause skips the hit; 0.5.7 used DamageCause.ENVIRONMENT), and a zero-length knockback direction falls back to (0,1,0). The native fixture sets knockback false, so this is not measured here.
wire_order (UUID text ascending) is not re-derived.
confirmed_on_072: Phase order blocks, then entities, then effects: ExplosionUtils.performExplosion (0.7.2) calls processTargetBlocks, then processTargetEntities when damageEntities is set, then performExplosionEffects. The debug spheres sit behind debugShapes().
Raw damage entityDamage*pow(1-d/entityDamageRadius, entityDamageFalloff): unchanged in processTargetEntity (the changed bytecode follows the positive-damage test).
Math.round before health subtraction: DamageSystems$ApplyDamage.handle invokes Math.round(F)I, and its normalised body is identical on both jars (the class is not pinned).

The bench-gate and craft-quantity claims depend on these. The recipe corpus 1,947 -> 2,047 is an expectation with no recorded 0.7.2 value (EXPECTED_ASSET_METRICS). 16 of 24 pinned classes differ; 66 changed bodies in 574 common methods.

verified_claims: containers: section IDs -2 storage, -3 armor, -1 hotbar, -5 utility, -8 tools, -9 backpack are unchanged (javap -constants on InventoryComponent, both jars); getComponentTypeById maps each of the six to the same class as on 0.5.7 (0.7.2 tableswitch -12..-1, 0.5.7 -9..-1); <clinit> (EVERYTHING) is identical. 0.7.2 adds -10 DUMMY (no component), -11 AbilitySlots and -12 RuneBag.

item and slot reads: ItemStack.getItemId, getQuantity, getDurability, getMaxDurability and getMetadata, Inventory.getActiveHotbarSlot, getActiveUtilitySlot and getActiveToolsSlot have identical normalised bodies on both jars; ItemContainer.getCapacity is abstract and its implementations (SimpleItemContainer, CombinedItemContainer, EmptyItemContainer, FetchedItemContainer, ItemStackItemContainer, DelegateItemContainer) are identical.

bridge (0.7.2 port, read only): observation/NativeInventoryFrame.java:35-44 SECTION_IDS = -2,-3,-1,-5,-8,-9 in the audit's order and requires all six (:55-62); observation/NativeInventoryCapture.java:20 reports inventory_unavailable, :34-36 reads the three active slots, :61 uses Short.toUnsignedInt(getCapacity()), :65 skips empty stacks, :74 reports metadata presence only; quantity is an int with a positive check (NativeInventoryFrame.java:237).

mutation paths changed on 0.7.2 (ItemStack.isStackableWith, equals, hashCode, with*; ItemContainer.internal_moveItemStackFromSlot, internal_sortItems) are outside the telemetry; the boundary claims (no mutation or transaction semantics, no metadata payload) still describe the telemetry.
caveats: transport.schema names hytalerl_native_inventory_v1, but both bridges emit hytalerl_native_inventory_v2 (hytale-plugin/.../observation/NativeInventoryFrame.java:24 and hytale-plugin-0.7.2/.../observation/NativeInventoryFrame.java:24). The static text is in the hashed payload and in the 0.5.7 pin. It is not a 0.7.2 build property; correcting it re-pins the 0.5 line too. Recorded anyway; revert this entry to null if the schema is to be corrected first.
The three 0.7.2 containers (abilities, rune bag, dummy) are outside the six-container telemetry; runes remain a stub (FIDELITY #69).
